greenest.linePrev: But once you knew a girl and you named her Lover
greenest.line: Danced with her in kitchens through the greenest summer
stanza: Saying everything you've ever seen was just a mirror
Spent your whole life sweating in an endless fever
And now you're laying in a bathtub full of freezing water
But once you knew a girl and you named her Lover
Danced with her in kitchens through the greenest summer
You can't remember where she said she was going to
